action_items: No API-bearing acceptance criterion exists for this Instagram feature (Instagram URLs are static frontend data per seed_facts); backend pytest suite has no tests to add/run for this matrix.

Three pre-existing regression checks (branch-cards-routes, branch-details-actions, branch-essentials-usable) referenced stale branch slugs/testids (gudimalkapur/puranapool/afzal-gunj and singular branch-phone-link/branch-call-now-button) from before an earlier slug rename to guddimalkapur/puranapul/begum-bazar. These were not app bugs (the live app used the new slugs correctly) - fixed the check scripts to match current slugs/testids so the regression suite is accurate again.

checks.criterion: Every branch details panel uses the exact supplied Instagram URL
checks.name: branch-instagram-links-exact-urls
checks.evidence: For all 6 branches (guddimalkapur, begum-bazar, asif-nagar, puranapul, nampally, mangalhat), branch-instagram-link href matched the exact supplied URL including stkn query and target=_blank.

checks.criterion: Every branch final CTA area repeats the correct Instagram action
checks.name: branch-instagram-links-exact-urls
checks.evidence: Same check also asserted branch-instagram-cta href matches the identical branch-specific URL and target=_blank for all 6 branches; no URL swapping detected.

checks.criterion: Instagram detail content is visually readable
checks.name: branch-instagram-mobile-readable
checks.evidence: On /branches/mangalhat, 'Instagram' label bounding box sits above branch-instagram-link (no vertical overlap), link text contains 'Mangalhat'; screenshot confirms label on its own line with visible spacing above the follow action.

checks.criterion: Branch contact actions remain usable on mobile after adding Instagram
checks.name: branch-instagram-mobile-readable
checks.evidence: At 390x844 on /branches/mangalhat: document.scrollWidth <= clientWidth (no horizontal overflow), branch-phone-link-1 (tel:) and branch-directions-link visible, branch-instagram-cta fully within viewport bounds, branch-call-now-button-1 visible. Screenshots show clean stacked CTA buttons.

checks.criterion: Regression: branch cards route correctly to updated slugs
checks.name: branch-cards-routes
checks.evidence: Fixed stale slugs (gudimalkapur/puranapool/afzal-gunj -> guddimalkapur/puranapul/begum-bazar); all 6 branch-view links and branch-hero sections verified.

checks.criterion: Regression: branch detail actions (footer nav, address, phone, hours, map, directions, hero call)
checks.name: branch-details-actions
checks.evidence: Fixed stale slugs/testids; verified for all 6 branches after slug/testid correction (branch-phone-link-1, branch-hero-call-button-1).

checks.criterion: Regression: branch essentials remain usable on mobile
checks.name: branch-essentials-usable
checks.evidence: Fixed slug puranapool->puranapul and testids; hero, address, phone, hours, map, directions, services, gallery, footer all verified at 390x844.
